recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-16965 unless MnM makes a new decision to allow Group to act as an Annotation author.
issue_request: Published/Not Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core datatypes request from MnM asking to add Group to Annotation.authorReference and asking why Annotation.text was not markup; the final resolution rejected Group and agreed to make text markup/markdown.
initial_application: Commit f5365429a97de1065e0df7297f110f707e198aa0, labelled GF#16965, changed Annotation.text in source/datatypes/annotation.xml from string to markdown and updated the wording. No source-history evidence shows Group being added for this issue.
additional_context: Annotation is active and normative in source/fhir.ini. Current source/datatypes/annotation.xml allows Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Patient, RelatedPerson, Organization, Device, or string for Annotation.author[x], omits Group, and uses markdown for Annotation.text. Later Annotation author issues added Organization, PractitionerRole, and Device but did not reverse the Group rejection. FHIR-15743 independently requested the same markdown change and Jira comments say it was already done under GF#16965.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the authoritative current source already implements the accepted markdown change and preserves the rejected Group author state.
